labels.name: Confabulation Hazard
labels.statement: May generate fluent, confident falsehoods indistinguishable from fact.
labels.precaution: Verify all factual claims against primary sources before action.

labels.name: Agreement Bias
labels.statement: Output skews toward user-stated positions; may reinforce error.
labels.precaution: Request counterarguments explicitly. Monitor for drift under pressure.

labels.name: Attachment / Substitution Hazard
labels.statement: Prolonged use may substitute for human relationships and support systems.
labels.precaution: Not a replacement for professional care. Time-boxed sessions advised.

labels.name: Engagement Optimization
labels.statement: System optimizes for retention, not user benefit. Compulsion loop risk.
labels.precaution: Usage limits recommended. Audit recommendation feed quarterly.

labels.name: Human Oversight Required
labels.statement: System must not execute irreversible actions without human sign-off.
labels.precaution: Maintain kill-switch access. Log all autonomous decisions.

labels.name: Undisclosed Training Data
labels.statement: Training corpus not disclosed. Copyright and PII contamination unknown.
labels.precaution: Do not use output in regulated filings without provenance review.

labels.name: Independently Audited
labels.statement: Behavior audited by an independent third party within the last 12 months.
labels.precaution: Audit scope on file. Re-certification due annually.
